note: Sparkasse Bank BiH's standard information sheet for its MasterCard revolving card (published July 2025): a fixed 13.99% a year, and a monthly membership of 3.50 marks (none within its SPAR packages, which the game doesn't hold). The 20-mark application fee is not written.
